acceptanceCriteria: `script/measure-worktree-index-share.sh` run against three linked worktrees at one commit reports 1 BUILT and 2 fresh snapshot reuses, and one copy of the clean snapshot bytes exists for the shared commit.

Each worktree's dirty view stays private to that worktree (DIRTY-CACHE-003 and DIRTY-CACHE-004 unchanged), the IDX-SNAP-V0-005 symlink refusal and DIRTY-CACHE-007 eviction still hold for the shared location, and the concurrent-writer rule is specified and tested with atomic rename.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the V1-0198 measurement (DIRTY-CACHE-003). The snapshot directory is joined to the worktree root (internal/contextindex/snapshot.go:30 snapshotSubpath ".corvint/index", :142-144 SnapshotDirectory, :166-167 snapshotPath), so each linked worktree at the same commit builds and stores its own full clean snapshot. Measured with script/measure-worktree-index-share.sh: 3 builds of 6.0-8.5 s under load average ~80, 3 x 72,803,003 = 218,409,009 bytes, 0 bytes under the Git common directory; a query without a snapshot rebuilds on every run (2.3-4.7 s against 1.1-1.7 s on a hit). Fix direction: key the clean base under the Git common directory by (object format, tree OID, engine), keep the dirty overlay per worktree, preserve symlink refusal and eviction, decide the one-writer rule, and publish by atomic rename because snapshot bytes are not deterministic across builds (observed OIDs fafb2a52 then 90c2855f; cause unconfirmed).

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #132 (merge 2f0fe1fbf); PR #138 (merge fc511808c) repointed the stale spec citations. Criterion 1: script/measure-worktree-index-share.sh against the PR build reported 1 BUILT and 2 fresh across three linked worktrees, 0 worktree snapshot bytes and one 72,890,863-byte .gob under the common dir (BUILD-LOG V1-0212 entry, docs/BUILD-LOG.md:183-205). Criterion 2: DIRTY-CACHE-013 (docs/specs/revision-cache-dirty-worktree-v0.md:83-99) keeps dirty views per worktree (DIRTY-CACHE-003/004), extends the IDX-SNAP-V0-005 symlink refusal and scales the DIRTY-CACHE-007 bound for the shared store, and specifies lock-free atomic-rename publication. Tests in internal/contextindex/snapshot_test.go include TestLinkedWorktreesShareOneCleanSnapshot (:631), TestConcurrentWorktreeWritersPublishCompleteSnapshotsByRename (:696), TestSharedSnapshotStoreKeepsTheEntryBoundAcrossWorktrees (:756) and TestWriteSnapshotRefusesCommittedSymlinkedSnapshotDirectory (:510); all pass at 6d4873a. Owner-only: new DIRTY-CACHE-013 and amended accepted IDX-SNAP-V0-001/005 and SOP-V0-002/004/005 await owner review. NOT_RUN: full cmd/corvint package, hostile-regressions-check. Follow-ups: store dir not fsynced after rename; readBlobFacts resolves the store separately; core.sharedRepository is unsupported. Sealed at .corvint/changes/3ef78756a326ee41c27b11bbb151c33ec6bb23bd.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, snapshot.go, snapshot_test.go, revision-cache-dirty-worktree-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: index: linked worktrees at one commit each rebuild and store the full clean snapshot
